{
  "sql": "SELECT DISTINCT m.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, m.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, m.max_phase, m.first_approval
FROM molecule_dictionary m
JOIN compound_records cr ON m.molregno = cr.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE m.max_phase IN (3, 4)
  AND cr.record_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, m.max_phase, m.first_approval;"
}

SELECT DISTINCT m.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, m.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, m.max_phase, m.first_approval

JOIN compound_records cr ON m.molregno = cr.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno

  AND cr.record_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, m.max_phase, m.first_approval;
